materials.name: lib_plaster
materials.role: Olive plaster for walls, ceiling, cornice. Small tiling mottle multiplied by COLOR_0 light memory.

materials.name: lib_floor
materials.role: Smoked floorboards, matte. Tiling boards multiplied by COLOR_0 light memory.

materials.name: lib_oak
materials.role: Honey oak: door leaf, desk top, shelf, coaster, controller cheeks, drum sticks. Shared grain strip with end-grain block.

materials.name: lib_dark_oak
materials.role: One dark trim timber: beams, skirting, architrave, window frame and sill. Same grain image, dark factor.

materials.name: lib_weave
materials.role: Cloth: rug, desk mat, acoustic fabric, stool tops, speaker cloth. Greyscale weave, tint per object through COLOR_0.

materials.name: lib_linen_shade
materials.role: Lamp shade only: shared weave plus emissive core-to-rim ramp.

materials.name: lib_palette
materials.role: Every flat-colour surface: ivory and black plastic, rubber, ceramic, pastel caps, brass, brushed and black metal, paper, leaf. One swatch atlas with matching metallic-roughness atlas; UV islands collapse onto swatch centres.
materials.note: Replaces the pilot one-off lib_brass, lib_brushed_metal, lib_black_metal, lib_linen_trim in the full-kit profile. Metal swatches authored at metalness 0.6 or lower because the runtime has no environment map.

materials.name: lib_glow
materials.role: Fixture diffusers and small indicators: pendant lens, wall triangles, lamp bulb, controller display, PC interior. Emissive ramp atlas so each diffuser has a core and a falloff, never a flat card.
materials.note: Supersedes pilot lib_bulb. Uses KHR_materials_emissive_strength, already allowed by the pilot profile.

materials.name: lib_contact
materials.role: Soft contact shadow decals, merged per support surface.

materials.name: rt_placeholder
materials.role: Placeholder on runtime-authored surfaces (three targets, three borders, fourth display, dusk pane). The runtime replaces it; its look is never evidence.

rules: Face and border are parallel planes; border sits behind the face and overhangs it by 10 mm on every side (current 13.75 mm).
The bezel lip surrounds the border and is flush with the face plane, so the highlight reads as an inset line and nothing opaque lies in front of the face.
No opaque geometry other than listed foreground props may cross the pyramid from the eye to any face. Home pose must stay 81 of 81 sample rays clear on all three faces.
Face and border meshes carry no bevel, no modifier and no extra vertices.

coverageEnvelopeDeg.basis: yaw and pitch bounds plus half-frusta for 21:9 desktop at FOV 58 and tall phones at FOV 76

transferBytesCompressed.basis: gzip. Pilot v03 measured about 47 bytes per triangle raw and about 12.7 gzip after removing its PNGs. Re-measured at M1.
